Indian Army rescues teenage girl from Mendhar Nala in Jammu & Kashmir

The Indian Army rescued a teenage girl who was found floating in the Mendhar Nala, a stream in the Mendhar area of Poonch district, Jammu & Kashmir. Reports said the girl was being swept downstream towards the Pakistan-administered side of the border. Army personnel retrieved her from the water and brought her to safety. The incident was covered by both The Tribune and Republic World. No further details on her condition or how she entered the water were provided.
